brief:
Israeli forces struck an electric motorcycle Thursday near the Palestinian Red Crescent building in the Al-Amal district west of Khan Younis, southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Two Palestinians sustained critical injuries in the attack, according to local sources at the scene.

The strike hit the motorcycle as it traveled near the Red Crescent facility in the residential neighborhood. Medical personnel responded to treat the wounded, whose conditions were described as critical. The incident marked another strike in the densely populated area of Khan Younis, where similar attacks have occurred in recent weeks.
